title: Solo/Small-team devs: which scales better financially in 2026 — Mobile F2P or Steam Premium?
author: Easy_Ad3278
selftext:
I'm a solo developer from Brazil and I'm trying to decide where to focus my next projects.

My goal is not just to launch a game, but to build a sustainable business that can scale over time.

For developers who have experience with both platforms:

* Which has provided the best return on investment (ROI)?
* Which is easier to grow with a small team?
* Which requires less marketing budget to get traction?
* If you were starting from scratch today, would you choose Mobile or Steam/Desktop?
* What are the biggest challenges that most beginners underestimate?

I'm especially interested in real-world experiences, numbers, postmortems, and lessons learned rather than theory.

Thanks!

comments.author: JorgitoEstrella
comments.body: No a dev, but mobile games have basically 0 discoverability and you will need to spend wayyy more in ads compared to pc to get noticed.

comments.author: fsk
comments.body:
Steam.  Think of it this way, your goal is to get 10,000 people to spend $10.

For mobile ftp, the big players have lots of user data.  They also can cross-promote their games by putting an ad for one game in one of their other games.
